title: 第一卷 第23章 孝心大发的顾尘第一卷 第24章 都不流血不死人也有脸叫试炼
content_zh:
吴良没说话。
可心里却有一句极脏的话想要送给顾尘！
你一个孤儿！
我喊杀你全家，对你有威胁吗，你他娘的……反应这么大做什么！！！
被顾尘打脸，被顾尘反击败，甚至被顾尘追得屁滚尿流……他都没有破防。
可——
这一刻，他确实有点破防了。
“你！有必要么！”
“你不懂……”
顾尘抬头看着那稀疏的月光，又叹了口气。
他没有家人。
他却有一个相依为命的老头子，一个他在这个世界上最亲，也最不能失去的老头子。
老头子要吃饱。
老头子要穿暖。
老头子要好好的，老头子也要娶上媳妇。
这是他的执念。
“所以……”
“我虽然是个孤儿，可我其实很孝顺的。”
吴良：“？？？”
他突然觉得，输在一个野路子手里，其实不是什么难以接受的事。

可……
输在一个脑子有问题的人手里，就很悲哀了。
“你有钱吗？”
顾尘却不管他怎么想，此刻孝心大发，又开始为了老头子的聘礼钱惆怅忧郁了起来，很认真问了一句。
吴良目光呆滞。
下意识看向了自己的储物袋。
顾尘顺手扯了下来，检查了一番。
灵石小一千，丹药十余瓶，一些叫不上名字的灵草材料**种，还有家传的风雷诀一本。
此外。
还有一枚拇指大小，莹白如雪的玉符，不知道是做什么用的。
他眉头大皱。
论身家，吴良自是比其他人丰厚了太多。
只是——
“不够，太少了！”
这么点东西。
别说买下一个世界了，怕是连个犄角旮旯都买不到！
闻言。
吴良眼中顿时闪过一丝希望！
这人，挺贪心的？
“其实这紫云山内，还有一件宝贝，价值连城，在我们几个的试炼之地。”
content_en:
Wu Liang said nothing.
But there was a very dirty word in my heart that I wanted to say to Gu Chen!
You are an orphan!
I shouted to kill your whole family, does that pose a threat to you? What the hell are you... Why are you reacting so loudly? ! !
He was slapped in the face by Gu Chen, defeated by Gu Chen, and even chased to pieces by Gu Chen... He didn't break his defense.
But——
At this moment, he did break his defense a bit.
"You! Is it necessary!"
"You don't understand..."
Gu Chen looked up at the sparse moonlight and sighed again.
He has no family.
But he has an old man who depends on him for life, the old man he is closest to in this world and the one he cannot lose the most.
The old man needs to eat.
The old man needs to dress warmly.
The old man wants to be well, and the old man also wants to marry a wife.
This is his obsession.
"So..."
"Although I am an orphan, I am actually very filial."
Wu Liang: "???"
He suddenly felt that losing to a wild man was actually not something that was difficult to accept.
But...
It would be very sad to lose to a person with a brain problem.
"Do you have money?"
Gu Chen didn't care what he thought. At this moment, he was very filial and he started to feel melancholy about the old man's betrothal gift money. He asked him a serious question.
Wu Liang's eyes were dull.
Subconsciously he looked at his storage bag.
Gu Chen pulled it off and checked it.
There are a thousand small spiritual stones, more than ten bottles of elixirs, some unnamed spiritual grass materials, and a copy of the Wind and Thunder Jue passed down from the family.
also.
There is also a jade talisman about the size of a thumb, as white as snow, whose purpose is unknown.
He frowned.
In terms of net worth, Wu Liang is much richer than others.
Just——
"Not enough, too little!"
Such a little thing.
Not to mention buying a whole world, I'm afraid I can't even buy a corner!
Hear the words.
A glimmer of hope suddenly flashed in Wu Liang's eyes!
Is this person quite greedy?
"Actually, there is another treasure in Ziyun Mountain, which is priceless, and it is in the trial place of several of us."
